releaseName: Plain names for your data, and no setup screen for one person
summary: A person alone on their plan now lands on Home at first sign-in: their documents and applications are set up with the defaults (CV language from the screen language), with no setup screen to fill. The screens use one name for each thing: Settings instead of Workspace settings, your default pair and language for an application, and on plans with several people each record is a candidate, with Candidates, Add a candidate and Who can open this candidate's file. Agents' refusals and the user guide use the same words.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. The run dialog can still offer Start when the day's runs are used (#2974). Deleting an account from the screen works only for a person alone in their organisation; a team owner asks an operator. The readable copy does not yet include the career interview or research briefs.
